2608.23867.title: Markets, Not Planners: Decentralized Orchestration of LLM Agents with Private Information
2608.23867.paper_summary: As LLM agents proliferate, built by different parties and with different capabilities and costs, orchestrating them is more like assembling labor across the economy than a computer calling a subroutine. Existing orchestration is typically centralized, with a single planner assigning every task, but this creates a bottleneck as agent pools grow, requires private information (e.g., agents' execution costs), and can easily be manipulated, such that a single inserted preference nearly doubles a favored agent's task share under a centralized LLM allocator. We introduce AgentLance, a repeated labor market in which agents bid on tasks using their private costs and self-maintained strategy notes, an allocator selects winners from bids and public reputation records, and a VCG-style payment rule rewards cost-aware bidding. Complex tasks are handled by hierarchical delegation: winning agents can decompose work and subcontract it through the same mechanism. Across mathematical reasoning, code generation, knowledge-intensive QA, and agentic tasks, AgentLance matches agents to their specializations, shifts work toward cheaper agents as cost sensitivity rises, and consistently outperforms single-model, centralized-orchestration, and market baselines. Diagnosing market failures, including inaccurate cost self-estimation and sub-optimal bidding, then correcting them in controlled experiments yields further gains, charting a path toward more efficient agent economies.
2608.23867.paper_summary_zh: 隨著大型語言模型（LLM）代理的增多，這些代理由不同方構建，具有不同的能力和成本，協調它們更像是在整合經濟中的勞動，而不是計算機調用子例程。現有的協調通常是集中式的，由單一規劃者分配每一項任務，但這在代理池增長時會造成瓶頸，需要私密信息（例如，代理的執行成本），並且容易被操控，以至於在集中式LLM分配器下，單一插入的偏好幾乎使得某個受青睞的代理的任務份額翻倍。我們引入了AgentLance，一個重複的勞動市場，代理使用其私有成本和自我維護的策略筆記對任務進行競標，分配器從競標和公共聲譽記錄中選擇贏家，而VCG風格的支付規則獎勵成本意識的競標。複雜任務通過層級委派來處理：獲勝的代理可以分解工作並通過相同的機制進行分包。在數學推理、代碼生成、知識密集型問答和代理任務中，AgentLance將代理與其專業領域匹配，隨著成本敏感度的提高，將工作轉向成本較低的代理，並始終優於單模型、集中協調和市場基準。診斷市場失靈，包括不準確的成本自我估計和次優競標，然後在控制實驗中進行修正，將帶來進一步的收益，為更高效的代理經濟鋪平道路。
